owner_and_capability: The owner compositions build what the server root took from implementation roles of other owners (ADR 0053 point 2): Workforce (modules/workforce/compose/httpadapter) serves the absence-type and substitution routes, Data Import (modules/dataimport/compose) returns the import file decoder, and Scheduler Runtime (the new modules/schedulerruntime/compose) binds the job runtime and the Worker lease store to the scheduler's TenantRuntime and LeaseStore ports. Closes #4003.
affected_tables: None: the Worker lease store keeps its statements on platform.worker_leases, and no DDL changes.
atomic_cutover: One PR, two commits. The first moves the Workforce routes and the Data Import decoder: AbsenceTypesRoutes and SubstitutionsRoutes in modules/workforce/compose/httpadapter return chi.Router (a Workforce composition may not name the inbound resources, and workforce/compose importing workforce/inbound would close an import cycle through the inbound tests and services); NewFileDecoder in modules/dataimport/compose; policy epoch 42 -> 43 adds owner-compose.workflow.adapter under reviewedOwnerCompositionRule. The second adds the package modules/schedulerruntime/compose (scheduler-runtime/compose) with NewTenantRuntime and NewWorkerLeaseStore and the rule scheduler-runtime.compose.tenant-runtime, anchored to the new package; the root keeps the lease name, holder, timings and metrics evidence. The four keys fall, baseline 46 -> 42, policy rules 1,438 -> 1,440, composition surface 252 -> 252, target cycle graph unchanged. The tenant-runtime rule is the one new cross-owner reach of an owner composition (the #4004 count goes from 206 to 207); the issue comment in the prerequisites records that decision.
tests: modules/schedulerruntime/compose: TestWorkerLeaseStoreBindsTheDatabaseLeaseToTheSchedulerPort drives Acquire, standby, Renew, Release, the token increase and Assert through the scheduler port and checks scheduler.ErrLeaseNotHeld with errors.Is.

modules/workforce/inbound, modules/workforce/compose/httpadapter, modules/dataimport/inbound/compose, modules/dataimport/fileformat and services/scheduler suites, unchanged.
internal/architecture and the test ratchets (TestPolicyTemporaryRules, TestCompositionInventory) with the regenerated line numbers in composition.json.

scripts/backend-architecture.sh check and validate-ticket --all against the development merge base; scripts/backend-architecture.sh cycles --graph target; scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development; scripts/test-backend.sh.

The root mounts the same resources, hands the same decoder value and binds the same job runtime and lease store as before; only the package that constructs them moves. The evidence is the suites, the architecture check and a localhost smoke run of the native backend, not a benchmark rerun. Source-location maintenance in #4078: the deleted Workforce routing wrapper is represented by the same runtime bindings now hosted in Root; historical observations above are unchanged.
